overview_description.description: Servislet is a technology-driven vertical marketplace dedicated to the automotive after sales industry. We empower consumers with transparent, convenient, and cost-effective access to vehicle needs like tires, maintenance, and repairs, while enabling businesses with digital tools to streamline operations, increase visibility, and grow efficiently. Servislet is building the leading digital marketplace for automotive after sales, connecting consumers with trusted retailers like tires, maintenance, and repairs, while enabling businesses with data-driven tools to optimize operations and grow profitably — unlocking a multi-billion-dollar market ripe for digitization.

about_short_description.short_description: Technology-driven vertical marketplace dedicated to the automotive after sales industry.

product.name: Servislet Marketplace
product.description: A digital platform for buying and selling automotive products and services, including tires, maintenance, and spare parts.

product.name: Servislet Pro
product.description: A SaaS application for automotive dealers to manage business processes, customer relations, and e-commerce activities.

product.name: Click and Collect Project
product.description: A digital solution enabling customers to search, purchase, and schedule tire delivery and installation through a unified platform.

product.name: Tire Sales and Services
product.description: Online sales of various tire types including summer, winter, all-season, run-flat, and specialty tires for different vehicle categories.

product.name: Motor Oil Sales
product.description: Online retail of motor oils from various brands suitable for different engine types and vehicle needs.

product.name: Periodic Maintenance Services
product.description: Scheduling and purchasing vehicle periodic maintenance packages through an online platform with appointment booking.
